from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    separators = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    colors = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in separators)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        top, bottom = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        out_row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            left, right = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            marked = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(top,bottom) for c in range(left,right))
            out_row.append(background if marked == 1 else 1)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
